beats.en: The primary sector uses natural resources, as in agriculture and dairy. The secondary sector turns raw material into goods, and the tertiary sector provides services such as transport, banking and teaching.
beats.speakEn: The primary sector uses natural resources, as in agriculture and dairy. The secondary sector turns raw material into goods, and the tertiary sector provides services such as transport, banking and teaching.

beats.en: Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is the value of all final goods and services produced in a country in a year. Only final goods are counted to avoid double counting.
beats.speakEn: Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is the value of all final goods and services produced in a country in a year. Only final goods are counted to avoid double counting.

textbookBox.concept: In the organised sector, jobs are regular and protected by laws. In the unorganised sector, jobs are irregular, wages are low and there is little protection.
